name: Songyue Guo
role: Ph.D. Student · Data Science and Analytics
headline:
Learning from data.
Reasoning with evidence.
bio: I am a Ph.D. student at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), supervised by Prof. Lei Chen. My research explores data-centric AI, language-model systems, and evidence-grounded reasoning.
background: Previously, I studied Computer Science and Technology at Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), advised by Prof. Qing Liao, and received my bachelor's degree from Shandong University, advised by Prof. Yilong Yin.
